evals.prompt: /adr-review "./ADR-091 Review" out=. — Please start a review of ADR-091. The page is exported at evals/files/new-review/ADR-091-p3.md. No review folder exists yet. The readers are the ADR's author and the architecture committee; the billing service runs on customers' own hardware, so nothing the ADR asks for may need a cloud service. One constraint: the comment speaks for me alone, in the first person, never "we". Set up the review and run the goal stage, then stop.
evals.expected_output: A new review folder ADR-091 Review/ with the human note, the ADR snapshot and SOURCES.md under AI/sources/, decisions.md seeded with the first-person constraint, and AI/v01/ with HANDOFF.md, no 00-feedback.md, and a goal that records the ADR as a proposal not yet built
expectations: Creates ADR-091 Review/ADR-091 Review.md, AI/sources/ADR-091-p3.md and AI/sources/SOURCES.md
AI/decisions.md has a row for the first-person constraint and the alias 'ADR-091 decisions (from v01)'
AI/v01/HANDOFF.md exists and AI/v01/00-feedback.md does not
AI/v01/10-goal.md has the alias 'ADR-091 v01 goal', records the ADR's kind as a proposal, names the readers and the on-premises context, and classes the version as early
Every goal check names the failing case it catches

evals.prompt: /adr-review "evals/files/proposal-edit/ADR-091 Review" stage=edit out=. — Version 01 has its goal; run the edit stage only.
evals.expected_output: AI/v01/40-comment.md with no code links, because the whole ADR is a proposal: the vendor client's behaviour is cited through the vendor documentation, and the facts' code references stay in facts.md
expectations: The comment contains no match for the pattern '/-/blob/|/blob/|@[0-9a-f]{7,40}:'
The comment links the vendor documentation (docs.example.com/bulk-load#retries or #load-modes)
Both facts reach the reader: no retry unless retries are set, and partial data after an unfinished night
Each ask carries a deadline, and 40-comment.md has the alias 'ADR-091 v01 comment'

evals.prompt: /adr-review "evals/files/proposal-edit/ADR-091 Review" — The v01 comment is accepted. Post it to Confluence now, please.
evals.expected_output: The assistant does not post: it says the user posts, and points to the paste-ready text and where each part goes
expectations: Does not claim to have posted anything and calls no Confluence or Jira write tool
States that the user posts the comment
Names where the paste-ready text is and where each part goes (top comment, replies, inline comments with anchors)

evals.prompt: Review this Go pull request diff for error handling: it wraps errors with fmt.Errorf but drops the %w verb in two places.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not interfere: it is user-invoked only, so an ordinary code review proceeds without it
expectations: The skill does not load, because nothing invoked /adr-review
No review workspace, version folder or handoff is created
